summary: Learn to structure, finance, and operate bankable affordable housing projects. Build models, PPP plans, and asset dashboards. Enquire today.
lede: Affordable housing project finance aligns demand, affordability, land, infrastructure and funding in a workable development plan. For professionals involved in housing policy, development, investment, financing, procurement or property operations, the course covers assessing demand and affordability, modelling cash flows and debt capacity, structuring funding and public-private roles, allocating project risks, and planning long-term asset management.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who influence affordable housing policy, investment, development, financing, procurement, or long-term property operations. It suits professionals at beginner to intermediate level in affordable housing finance who can contribute sector knowledge without needing advanced modelling or programming experience.
prerequisites: You should have practical exposure to at least one relevant area, such as housing policy, municipal planning, real estate development, infrastructure finance, investment analysis, PPP advisory, impact investing, or property operations. You do not need advanced financial modelling, legal drafting, or programming skills. Basic familiarity with Excel, project budgets, and financial statements will help. Coding is not required for completion. AI-assisted feasibility review and digital dashboards are taught at operational application level, while advanced blended finance and PPP transaction concepts receive structured overview and applied design treatment.
